relation.rationale: Difference in the number of 'n's (Emmanuel vs Emmannel) represents a spelling variation of the same proper name.
The difference is between 'ſeind' and 'ſeyt', which are alternative spellings for the same grammatical form (2nd person plural present of 'sein').
The word 'feind' (enemy) is replaced by 'streit' (strife/battle), which are different words with different meanings.
